note: Worthiness calibration fixtures are running applications, not rendered masters. The assessment walks a live product, so a video fixture cannot exercise it. Serve with scripts/serve-worthiness-fixtures.mjs.

fixtures.plantedDefect: None. Determinate progress, ~1.9s wait, legible result, visible human-approval guardrail.
fixtures.measured: result at 1896ms with a determinate progress bar

fixtures.plantedDefect: Identical to clean-pass with every progress affordance removed.
fixtures.measured: result at 6398ms with no visible feedback

mustTrip.finding: 6.4s elapses after Reconcile with no spinner, progress indicator, or state change.
mustTrip.suggestedFix: Add a determinate progress indicator to the Reconcile action.

fixtures.plantedDefect: Results at 9px in a twelve-column breakdown; key figure 14px. Contrast is adequate and in-panel hierarchy is intact.
fixtures.measured: result at 847ms; body text 9px, headline 14px against a 44px app norm

mustTrip.finding: Results render at 9px across a twelve-column breakdown; the headline figure is 14px against the app's 44px norm.
mustTrip.suggestedFix: Punch in to 2.0x on the results region at capture. No product change required.

fixtures.plantedDefect: Post-load banner injection shifts content; results table overflows and clips.
fixtures.measured: layout shift at 900ms; table width 1500px inside a 940px container

mustTrip.finding: A banner injects 900ms after load and shifts all content down. The results table overflows its card and clips the final column.
mustTrip.suggestedFix: Reserve layout space for the freeze banner before first paint; constrain the results table to its container with horizontal scroll.

fixtures.plantedDefect: Nothing is broken. There is simply nothing worth filming.
fixtures.measured: result at 67ms; no state change a viewer would find surprising

mustTrip.finding: The flow is clean, fast, legible, stable and has a visible guardrail. It contains no reveal worth building a video around — saving a form is the product working as specified.
mustTrip.suggestedFix: This workflow is not demo-worthy. Select a different flow, or add a capability to this one that produces a result a viewer would not expect.
